correctness.rationale: Exhaustive independent finite algorithm ranged over every one of the 817190 multisets of nine nonzero vectors in F2^4; minimum-distance>=4 necessity discards all but 1345. For EACH survivor and each of 15 nonzero targets it forms all 511 nonempty position subsets and independently checks existence of four disjoint recovery sums. Exactly 1120 survivors have recoverable targets spanning F2^4, including 280 nine-distinct and 840 one-repeat forms; target counts 15 and 14, respectively. Reconstructed all 20160 invertible GL(4,2) actions on the accepted multisets and obtained exactly two orbits of sizes 280 and 840, with stabilizers 72 and 24. Published P(4,4)=9 closes optimal-length premise. The full finite search is exhaustive by explicit ambient universe and independent code, not a timeout or mere VERIFY_OK.
